title: Frontend Interview Practice
summary: Build seven real-world frontend exercises, compare 21 TypeScript and 21 Python solutions, complete 56 checkpoint questions, and review with 42 scrolling cards.
audience: Engineers preparing to explain, implement, and test React and TypeScript solutions during technical interviews.

units.title: Dynamic Rectangular Board
units.summary: Render independently sized rows and columns and explain React identity, state, refs, and memoization.

units.title: Randomized Zero Matrix
units.summary: Select exactly k distinct zero positions while keeping generated React state stable and testable.

units.title: Click-to-place 5×5 Game
units.summary: Model legal turns and detect contiguous horizontal or vertical wins without adding unstated game rules.

units.title: Column-drop 6×7 Game
units.summary: Model legal turns and detect contiguous horizontal or vertical wins without adding unstated game rules.

units.title: Recursive File Explorer
units.summary: Combine both supplied tree briefs into a recursive explorer with explicit expansion-state behavior.

units.title: Multi-select with Removable Chips
units.summary: Model selection and derived filtering while preserving disabled options, keyboard access, and dismissal behavior.

units.title: Asynchronous User Repository Matrix
units.summary: Fetch user counts, handle partial failures, and place results in stable unique cells despite out-of-order requests.
